doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Tamsin's dash is the held Skate (RimewrightKit.in_dash); she has no air dash at all (Shift in the air waits for the landing), so 'air' is listed as never in DashFlow's sight. Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source.

lmb.source: Data: Skate is a held mode, released to stop. Footage (0239-0245, 0285-0290): she fires the whole skate and the darts become straight thick beams. Ours: darts fly as beams at normal damage (data pass); the skate goes on.

rmb.source: Data: nothing stops a cast during the held Skate. Footage: not shown. Ours: the spear aim and throw go on while she keeps skating.

e.source: Data: nothing stops a cast during the held Skate. Footage: not shown. Ours: the Rink Wall's tell and slide start while she keeps skating.

x.source: Data: the ult makes her invulnerable inside a slowing zone; footage (ult f25-f55): she is rooted in the crystal. Ours: Rimelock ends the skate and roots her at once.

q.source: No source glove; the skate is a held move, so a glove goes off from it like her abilities.

lmb.source: No air dash: Shift in the air buffers the Skate to the landing (owner item 12; the footage never starts a skate in the air).
Footage: she starts skating while firing and keeps firing; the darts turn to beams. Ours: the same.

air.reason: owner item 12: she has no air dash; Shift in the air waits for the landing
air.source: No air dash in the source (owner item 12).

rmb.source: Data: Skate can be held at any time. Ours: Shift during the spear aim or the throw's wind-up starts the skate and the throw still goes.
